[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/03/19 (Sun) 05:37
[USER] User asked about an idiom for silent treatment and its meaning.
[ASSISTANT_SAID] An idiom for the silent treatment is "give someone the cold shoulder."
[ASSISTANT_SAID] "Give someone the cold shoulder" means to deliberately ignore or show indifference to someone, often as a form of punishment or to express disapproval.
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The phrase "cold shoulder" may have originated from the idea that serving someone a cold shoulder of meat was a way of expressing disapproval or indicating that they were not welcome at the dinner table.
